## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D game inspired by Roblox Randomizer.

## Requirements
- Implement the game now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save and inspect a small JPEG screenshot for visual checks.

## Decisions
- Built a browser-based third-person arena shooter named CHAOS//ARENA, with randomized weapons, bots, and timed rerolls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with a Three.js arena, player and bots, combat, six weapons, rounds, HUD, start/end menus, keyboard and touch controls.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002` in tmux session `chaos-game`.
- Opened the app in Playwright and inspected `/tmp/opencode/chaos-screen.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/chaos-playing.jpg`; the arena and gameplay screen rendered.
- Installed Chromium using `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`.

### Active
- Fix and verify combat input/targeting. Current `doShoot()` raycasts character meshes, but bot models are Groups; the recent targeted edit to fix this failed because its exact source text did not match.
